name: Sleep descent: morning check-in
summary: A short morning rating of the night, kept apart from the sleep descent so that the phone does not stay lit all night: time to fall asleep, awakenings, sleep quality and grogginess. Use it every morning of a series, including nights without the sleep descent, so the nights can be compared.
setting: Right after you get up, before you look at last night's run summary.
cautions: Estimates of sleep time are rough. These ratings are not a diagnosis; see a doctor if sleep problems persist.

sources.title: Monroe RA, US Patent 5,356,368 (1994): method and apparatus for inducing desired states of consciousness (sleep timeline, phased pink sound, 6 s cycle)

steps.title: Morning check-in
steps.instructions: When you get up, rate the night, before you look at the run summary of last night's session. Answer on nights without the sleep descent too: the ratings are most useful when you compare nights with the guide, nights without it and sham nights, in random order.

items.label: Did you use the sleep descent last night? (0 = no, 1 = yes)
